title.en: Find the advertising packets in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and show only BLE advertising PDUs.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur sirf BLE advertising PDUs dikhao.

expect.en: ADV_IND packets on channels 37, 38 and 39 with access address 0x8e89bed6, plus SCAN_REQ, SCAN_RSP and CONNECT_IND.
expect.hinglish: Channels 37, 38 aur 39 par access address 0x8e89bed6 wale ADV_IND packets, saath mein SCAN_REQ, SCAN_RSP aur CONNECT_IND.

why.en: ATT requests, responses and notifications make up GATT: service discovery, the CCCD write, then heart-rate notifications.
why.hinglish: ATT requests, responses aur notifications se GATT banta hai: service discovery, CCCD write, phir heart-rate notifications.

expect.en: Read By Group Type, Write Request to handle 0x000f, Write Response and repeating Handle Value Notifications on 0x000e.
expect.hinglish: Read By Group Type, handle 0x000f par Write Request, Write Response aur 0x000e par baar-baar Handle Value Notifications.

why.en: The Security Manager Protocol carries the public keys, confirm values and failure codes in the MITM scenario.
why.hinglish: Security Manager Protocol MITM scenario mein public keys, confirm values aur failure codes carry karta hai.

expect.en: Pairing Request/Response (IO capabilities), Public Key exchange, then Pairing Failed with reason 0x0c when numeric comparison fails.
expect.hinglish: Pairing Request/Response (IO capabilities), Public Key exchange, phir numeric comparison fail hone par reason 0x0c ke saath Pairing Failed.

title.en: See the Bluetooth adapters on your own machine
title.hinglish: Apni machine ke Bluetooth adapters dekho

why.en: A read-only look at whether your PC has a Bluetooth radio and which devices it already knows. It does not scan or connect to anything.
why.hinglish: Read-only dekho ki tumhare PC mein Bluetooth radio hai ya nahi aur woh kaunse devices pehle se jaanta hai. Yeh kuch scan ya connect nahi karta.

expect.en: A list of Bluetooth radios and paired devices, or nothing if you have none. Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Bluetooth radios aur paired devices ki list, ya agar koi nahi hai to kuch nahi. Output machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.
